pages.title: The Citadel
pages.text: The $(l)Citadel$() is the largest single Charter structure in the known sky. A fortress-fragment, walled, towered, audited end-to-end. The Charter's central archives are filed there.$(br2)The senior administrators work out of the Citadel when they are not in transit.

Every senior Foreman, at some point, is invited to the Citadel. The invitation is a black-wax docket — not a recall, but a $(o)witnessing$(). The Charter wants the Foreman to see, in person, the institution they sign for.$(br2)It is a long flight. Survey ships are provided.

What the Foreman sees at the Citadel depends on what the Charter has decided to show them.$(br2)Most see the archive. Some see the audit chambers. A few see what is on the Citadel's lowest floor, and the Charter does not, after, ask them to write a docket about it.
